1.focus: Sautukan farko da kalmomi masu sauƙi na haruffa 3

2.focus: Sauran haruffan baƙaƙe, tare da ck, ff, ll, ss

3.focus: Haruffa biyu, sauti ɗaya — sh, ch, th, ng…

4.focus: Haɗe-haɗen wasali kamar ay, ee, igh, oo da ar

5.focus: Rababben haruffa biyu (a-e, i-e) da sababbin rubutu

6.focus: Wasu hanyoyin rubutu — wr, kn, ph, dge…

7.focus: Haruffa uku (ire, ore, ear) da ƙarshen -tion

chart.ariaLabel: Jadawalin kwatanta matakin fonetik bisa shekaru
chart.legendExpected: Abin da ake tsammani a Birtaniya (matsakaici)
chart.disclaimer: Bayanan tunani: UK DfE Phonics Screening Check 2024 (yawan cin jarrabawa na ƙasa ≈80% a ƙarshen Year 1) + ma'aunin karatu na NFER. An ƙiyasta layin duniya daga binciken iya karatu na IEA PIRLS 2021 (Birtaniya 558 da matsakaicin duniya 520). An daidaita matakan fonetik da tsarin karatunmu na 1–8, ba maki na jarrabawa masu daidaito ba ne. Wannan hoton ɗanku ne na ɗan lokaci, ba lakabi ba — ku yi magana da malaminsa don cikakken bayani.
